data: {{Top|notoc=1}} {{Character |type=Musician |image=[[File:Hhex.png]] |name=Hhex |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Palandag]]''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Black]] |skin=Green |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Hhex''' was a [[Palandag]] [[musician]] who played [[f'nonc horn]] in a band alongside fellow Palandags [[Jhat]] and [[Dhuz]]. Around [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] to [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] takes place immediately after the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it must also take place in approximately 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. the trio played in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].{{Film|VIII}} While playing at the [[casino]], the musician wore [[Color|brown]], traditional [[yekermo outer robe]]s over a brown [[Clothing|robe]] with a golden trim. The Palandag had green skin and black [[eye]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Hhex first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. Hhex and his band mates were designed by creature concept artist [[Tim Napper]] in a piece of concept art title "New Band 02".''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' ==Appearances== *{{Film|VIII}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Hhex}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' *{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-10-aliens-you-should-know-from-star-wars-the-last-jedis-canto-bight|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 10 Aliens You Should Know from Star Wars: The Last Jedi's Canto Bight}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Hhex#kanon |fr=Hhex |ja=ヘックス |pl=Hhex }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Musicians]] [[Category:Palandags]]
